title: Powder Blue Floral Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Set with Kota Doria Dupatta
color_custom: Powder blue with pink & green florals, ivory and red printed pants
description:
A garden in full bloom – a powder blue cotton kurta covered in pink, red and green jaal florals, hand block printed in Jaipur. The round neck with a small notch, 3/4 sleeves with a soft printed cuff and a floral border at the hem keep it graceful, while the ivory pants with red block printed motifs add a pop of contrast. The matching kota doria dupatta, printed in the same jaal with a blue edge and tassels, completes the look.

✦ The Details
• Straight cotton kurta with a notched round neckline and side slits, calf length
• All-over hand block printed floral jaal in pink, red and green on powder blue
• 3/4 sleeves with printed cuffs; printed floral border at the hem
• Ivory cotton pants with red hand block printed motifs and a printed hem
• Kota doria dupatta in the matching floral jaal with a blue edge and tassels
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
The kurta and pants are soft, breathable cotton, printed by hand with carved wooden blocks by karigars in Sanganer, Jaipur – one colour and one block at a time. The dupatta is kota doria, a featherlight handloom fabric from Rajasthan with its signature checked (khat) weave, also hand block printed. Small shifts and variations in the print are the mark of real handwork, not a defect.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, straight fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements at no extra cost.

✦ How to Style It
Silver statement earrings and juttis for the office or a family gathering. Pearl jewellery and nude heels for a festive brunch. Swap the pants for blue denim on a casual day.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Indigo dyes may release a little colour in the first few washes – wash separately in cold water. The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Dupatta (kota doria, hand block print, tassels)
care: Gentle hand wash separately in cold water with mild soap. Do not soak or wring. Dry inside-out in shade. Iron on medium heat from the reverse. Kota dupatta: dry clean or gentle hand wash.
